body.heading: Where in the world is Rwanda?
paragraphs: Rwanda is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Rwanda is Kigali.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Rwanda speak Kinyarwanda, English and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Rwanda is the Rwandan franc.

body.heading: How big is Rwanda?
paragraphs: Rwanda covers about 26,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Togo.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: In the misty Virunga volcanoes, families with older kids can trek to meet mountain gorillas — Rwanda's most famous residents — with expert guides.
Lake Kivu is one of Africa's Great Lakes, with green hills, island-dotted water and relaxed lakeside towns like Kibuye and Gisenyi for boat trips and swimming.
